verdict.rationale: Godot's official docs state that import parameters can be changed for several assets at once, a genuine first-party bulk operation, but the documented scope is narrow. EditorScript, EditorInterface and headless CLI automation are scripting building blocks a developer could use to build broader batch tooling, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented bulk operations beyond import parameters (e.g., multi-node or multi-resource editing, batch actions via CLI), agent-oriented batch workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Changing the import parameters of several assets at the same time is also possible.
